The first layer, the 10,000-world JEV engine, generates probabilistic player projections conditioned on a 26-layer ContextPacket. These projections undergo filtering through G1..G5 gates to produce a curated DFS pool. The second layer applies MILP optimization to construct lineups from this pool, incorporating archetype correlations. This pipeline ensures that each stage maintains integrity through conformal calibration and empirical shrinkage. Failure modes include overfitting to historical data, misalignment between simulation and market dynamics, and leakage from sub-optimal gate thresholds. The system's robustness stems from its layered validation and feedback loops.
